content.text: The refutation attempt found two overstatements but no reason to keep the implementation: the row-lock fence came via #4863, not #4537, and #5008 broadens guarded updates rather than strengthening `ClaimIssue` serialization itself. Those corrections matter for the closure rationale; neither creates a residual advisory-lock use case.

VERDICT: CONFIRM

- `internal/storage/issueops/claim.go:53-58,92-111` — every claim rewrites fresh `row_lock`; `internal/storage/dolt/issues.go:325-388` retries both claim paths after 1213/1205 conflicts.
- `internal/storage/dolt/lease_test.go:394-479` — deterministic real-Dolt test proves `row_lock` converts silent cell-merges into serialization conflicts.
- `internal/storage/dolt/concurrent_test.go:977-1080` — six actors drain 40 issues without duplicate, stranded, or errored claims.
- `internal/storage/dolt/dolt_test.go:149-175` — strongest caveat: that drain test uses one store and two connections, not six independent processes. A focused six-on-one direct-claim test remains worthwhile.
- `PR #4862:internal/storage/dolt/issues.go:211-328` — branch adds no test/harness, only the lock implementation. Its measurements used the pre-#4537 bare-transaction code, so there is nothing executable to absorb.
- `internal/storage/dolt/wisps.go:397-411` — direct wisp claims bypass the PR lock. Update/close/reclaim/unclaim never acquire it either; therefore it solves neither wisp nor non-claim races. Embedded storage is untouched.
- `internal/storage/schema/lock.go:37-48,70-105` — PR duplicates existing advisory-lock lifecycle code, omits its 64-byte name guard, globally serializes unrelated claims, and introduces a hard 10-second contention failure.
- Chronology correction: GH-3570 added claim CAS/anti-steal semantics; #4537 added retry, the original lease-carried `row_lock`, and drain test; #4863 refactored that fence into today’s `RowLockClause`.
- `internal/storage/dolt/claim_verify.go:16-40,141-189` — #5006 genuinely hardens claim outcomes. #5008 is adjacent guarded-update hardening, not literally the same `ClaimIssue` serialization path.
- Retire with credit. Preserve the reported six-on-one methodology as a focused follow-up test request, not this coarse advisory-lock implementation.
